title: Muscles ready today can say 'your last workout' but show the sets of an older, heavier workout
what: When a member trains a muscle hard (6 or more sets, 72 hours rest) and then lightly again the next morning (1 set, 48 hours rest), the page keeps the older workout because it ends the rest later. Tapping the muscle then says 'Your last workout gave it 6 sets', while the last workout gave it 1 set. The rest time shown is right; the set count is from a different workout than the words claim.
expected: The line names the workout the number comes from (for example 'the workout on Monday gave it 6 sets'), or the count shown is the last workout's.
who: members (page is switched off today; any old link still opens it)
how_often: two workouts of the same muscle within three days, the newer one lighter
fix_line: Say which day's workout set the rest, or word it 'the workout that set this rest'

items.reason: Facts shown in this area (index.tsx to start.tsx): Settings row lines (weekly goal, rest, units, widgets placed, Plus plan line), Records total, Ready today states, Quick workout minutes, hidden Nutrition totals, 1RM table. All but the Plus line are worked out on the phone from the member's own log, so no panel, HQ or export shows them. The Plus plan-end line is behind the plan switch and uses the one shared line maker already checked by the components-2 helper. Gym rows (inbox, orders, hours) sit in files outside this name range. No Crispy Curves count compares, since nothing here reads gym rows.

Records page from a monthly report link and the report itself read the same record list with the same date range, so 'See all N' and the page agree. Settings lines read the same stores the settings pages write.

Date numbers traced: Ready today rest (no workout yet shows the empty state; workout older than 72 hours counts as ready; today's workout counts as resting), 'last trained N days ago' (today, yesterday, weeks after a long gap), records month span, nutrition 'today'. A heavy then light workout of the same muscle is the edge that breaks.
Rule applied: the set count tied to 'your last workout' is wrong when an older heavier workout sets the rest.

Summaries with rows: Records subtitle (lifts that beat their best and record count) is worked out from the very rows listed; Nutrition totals are summed from the meals listed; the Ready lists are grouped from the same rows the body map colours. None of these screens shows a change against last time, so no drop needs a reason here.
No summary differs from its rows in this area.
Opened the files that make the numbers: rest rules, readiness reads, last-trained days, record list, report reads, lifts-up count.

Records: count by lifts-beating-best and rows by the same filtered record list. Ready today: muscle lists and the tapped line both come from one readiness rule; 'last trained' comes from a second function over every logged day.

Long-gap case: after weeks off, readiness finds no workout in the last 4 days so every muscle is ready, and the second function says 'Last trained N weeks ago'; the two agree. The two-function seam only breaks on the heavy-then-light case already recorded.
